description: This file defines a Flutter widget 'HealthCheck' that performs a connectivity and permissions check with a Supabase backend by attempting to read from a 'profiles' table and verifying authentication status. It displays the status and guidance for troubleshooting.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flutter StatefulWidget that provides a UI for performing and displaying the results of a health check against a Supabase backend.

methods.name: _runCheck
methods.description: Asynchronous method that performs connectivity tests by reading from the 'profiles' table and checking user authentication status, then updates the widget state based on success or failure.
